question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Blow hot and cold
solution:
The **c**orrect answer is: '**Vacillating'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"blow hot and cold"** means to sometimes like something and sometimes not, or to sometimes be very enthusiastic or positive about something and sometimes not.(धरा पर पड़ना).

 
 
• **For example-** "He has been blowing hot and cold about the project, making it difficult to progress".
 
 
 
• **'Vacillating'** is the most appropriate meaning for this idiom, which means 'waver between different opinions or actions; to be indecisive.' (अस्थिर).
 
 
• **For example-** "He has been vacillating between studying medicine or engineering".
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Vacillating'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Critiquing**' means to review or analyze critically.(समीक्षा करना)
 
• **'Tormenting'** is to cause great pain or suffering.(यातना देना)
 
• **'Rebuking' **means express sharp disapproval or criticism because of their behavior or actions.(फटकारना)
